title: Producer and consumer
summary: The classic bounded buffer with three semaphores.
hints: Three semaphores: `empty` starts at the buffer size (free slots), `full` at 0 (filled slots) and `mutex` at 1 (the buffer itself). Producer: `wait(empty) wait(mutex) put post(mutex) post(full)`. Consumer: `wait(full) wait(mutex) get post(mutex) post(empty)`.
Taking the two `wait`s in the other order can deadlock: never wait for the mutex while holding the only slot the other side needs.
